## Design Context

### Users
Customers discovering nearby marketplace stores and products so they can place an order. The experience should make location, availability, and next steps easy to understand.

### Brand Personality
Fair, transparent, heroic. Prioritize a clear, efficient experience that earns trust without obscuring practical details.

### Aesthetic Direction
Retain the existing Matrix dark/green identity. Use its green accents deliberately, with restrained glow and motion so marketplace content remains legible. No external reference sites or anti-references were specified.

### Design Principles
- Make nearby-store discovery and distance clear at a glance.
- Keep prices, availability, and store information transparent; do not imply unsupported ratings or claims.
- Favor readable hierarchy and efficient browsing over decorative Matrix effects.
- Keep core actions responsive and keyboard accessible, with WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and reduced-motion support.
- Preserve the Matrix green identity without relying on color alone to communicate status.
